name: Hinomiya Matsuri
source:
Likes: Sweet foods, taking care of others
Dislikes: Black coffee

Shun's classmate and best friend. Matsuri is a very caring and emphatetic person who gets along with everyone. She loves sweets and always has some in her pocket. She is also somewhat innocent as she doesn't know much about sex and perverted things.
